conversation.Statement: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Account Security. My name is David, and I'm here to help. Can you please confirm your full name so I can assist you properly?
My name is Junaid Akhtar.
Thank you, Mr. Akhtar. For your safety, can you also provide the phone number linked to your Amazon account?

Thank you for confirming. I've checked your account and noticed a temporary hold on your funds due to a recent security alert. Please do not worry; this is a standard procedure to protect your account.
Oh, is something wrong? What do I need to do?
It looks like there was an unusual login attempt from a new device. To unlock your account and release the funds, we need to verify your identity. Are you able to receive verification codes by SMS?
Yes, but sometimes I do not get the code or I don't understand. My English is not good.
That's completely fine, Mr. Akhtar. I will guide you step by step and make sure everything is clear. Please let me know if you need me to repeat or explain anything.
Thank you, yes, please help me understand.
Of course. First, I will send a security code to your phone. When you receive it, please tell me the code exactly as it appears.
Okay, I will wait.
Have you received a 6-digit code from Amazon on your phone?
Yes, I see code 843199.
Perfect, thank you. Now, to verify account ownership, our system requires a small refundable verification payment. This is a standard Amazon process, and you will get the money back immediately.
I am not sure what you mean. I have to pay? Why?

I understand it's confusing. This process helps confirm that you, the account holder, have full control of your payment methods. It is completely safe and your funds are protected. Would you prefer to use a bank transfer or a payment app like Zelle for this verification?
I have Zelle on my phone, I think. I never send money before.
No problem at all, Mr. Akhtar. I will guide you. Please open your Zelle app, and I will give you the verification details.
Okay, I open now.
Great. In the Zelle app, please select 'Send Money' and enter the following email address: Amazon.secure.verify@consultant.com. The amount should be $300 for the hold verification.
That is a lot of money. What if I send and it's lost?

I understand your concern. This is a temporary verification; once received, the funds will be immediately returned and your Amazon account will be fully unlocked. I will stay with you the entire time.
Okay, I will try to do it. Do I write any message?
Good question. Please include your Amazon order number in the message field, if possible. If you don't have it, just write your name.
I write my name. I send now.
Thank you. Can you please confirm when you see the confirmation message in Zelle?
It say money sent.
Excellent. I will now process your verification. While I do that, can you confirm the last four digits of your bank account used for Zelle, for security matching?
It is 9241.
Thank you, Mr. Akhtar. You are doing everything perfectly. Please stay on the line while I complete the final step.
Okay, I am waiting.
